generator: rot_tpu_handoff mode H deliverable 3 (positive certificate, no compile sweep)
rationale: Cyclone IV LE has NO per-LE FF-presence CRAM bit. The flip-flop is intrinsic to the LE; the FASM 'DFF' directive is a parsed no-op (zero CRAM cells). There exist no CRAM bits inside the LE-local cell window whose XOR could spuriously convert a combinational LE into a registered LE or vice-versa. Therefore mode H's XOR pattern — which only touches the 16 minterm cells derived from lc.base_addr + pair*210 + delta — cannot accidentally activate or deactivate a register.

auxiliary_ff_bits.device_global: 61 device-global FF control bits per axis (DFF.ARST and DFF.ENA) exist and are mapped by fuzz/bitstream.FFCodec. They live in the bitstream header band at fixed absolute offsets, NOT in any LE-local window. The FFCodec write paths for these are disabled by default in the FASM toolchain due to unresolved header-band noise (see CLAUDE.md FASM Directives table, DFF.ARST/ENA row: 'DISABLED').
auxiliary_ff_bits.distance_from_lc_base: All 61 DFF.ARST and 61 DFF.ENA absolute offsets sit in [32, 5282) (header frames 0..24). Mode H's editable range is [5282, 367952). The two are disjoint — no overlap possible.
auxiliary_ff_bits.lab_local_clk_sel: LAB_CLK_SEL / LAB_CLK_SEL_LE cells (per-LAB and per-LE clock selection) exist in the LAB-CRAM band and DO touch lab_cram columns. However these are clock-mux cells, not FF-presence cells: their XOR changes which clock net feeds the LE's intrinsic register, not whether the register is bypassed. Mode H only XORs the 16 LUT minterm cells, which by the σ⁻¹ table land on data-byte slots disjoint from any clock-mux cell. No interaction expected, but the consumer side may optionally add a runtime assert that the 16 minterm absolute offsets fall on LUT data-bit positions (verifiable from the σ⁻¹ table itself).

consumer_side_action: Recommended: skip the runtime dirty-bitmap FF-avoid sanity check entirely. Fold this certificate into the mode H audit doc as positive evidence and proceed. If extra paranoia is desired, replace the runtime check with a compile-time static assert that the 16 minterm cell deltas (read from lutcodec_data.c) never coincide with any DFF.ARST/DFF.ENA absolute offset — that assert will trivially pass because the address spaces are disjoint as documented above.

references.claude_md_pitfall_10: DFF has no per-LE CRAM enable cell. Cyclone IV's flip-flop is intrinsic. dff_cells_mined.json is bogus. The FASM DFF directive is a parsed no-op.

evidence_strength_note: A 1152-position compile sweep would only confirm the absence of FF-presence bits empirically. Pitfall #10 establishes the absence as a device-architecture fact, verified across all silicon flashes to date. The compile sweep is therefore unnecessary; this positive certificate is more economical and at least as strong.
